answer: Work waits on the grove until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the canyon of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure.
